media.caption: Supervised and unsupervised learning are two core machine learning approaches defined by the use of labeled data, the types of tasks they perform, and their primary goals.

text.headline:
Comparative Evolution of Supervised vs. Unsupersised Learning
1950- 2016
1950 - The Beginning of Machine Learning
text.text: Alan Turing introduced the idea that machines could imitate human intelligence through the Turing Test. This inspired future research that eventually led to supervised and unsupervised learning.

text.headline: 1957 Perception: Early Supervised Learning
text.text: Frank Rosenblatt developed the Perceptron, one of the first algoritms trained using labeled data.It learned to classify simple patterns,making it a milestone in supervised Learning.

text.headline: 1967 - K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
text.text: Supervised Learning The K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm became a popular method for classifying and predicting data.It determines the class of new data by comparing it to labeled examples.

text.headline: 1973 K-Means Clustering
text.text: Unsupervised Learning K-Means became one of the most widely used clusttering algorithms.Unlike supervised Learning, it groups similar data without requring labeled examples.

text.headline: 1986 - Backpropagation Improves Supervised Learning
text.text: Supervised Learning The Backpropagation algorithm enabled neural networks to learn more effectively from labeled datasets.It significantly improved the performance of image and speech recognation systems.

text.headline: 1990 - Data Mining Expands Unsupervised Learning
text.text: Unsupervised Learning As databases grew larger, clustering and association rule mining became important for discovering hidden patterns. Businesses began using these methods for customer segmentation and market analysis.

text.headline: Deep Learning
text.text: Unsupervised Learning AlexNet achieved outstanding results in the ImageNet competition using labeled images. This success accelerated the adoption of deep learning in computer vision.

text.headline: 2016 Ai complex Patters
text.text: Both AlphaGo combined supervised learning with reinforcement learning to defeat Go champion Lee Sedol. This demonstrated how different learning approaches could work together to solve complex problems.
